description.value: Neighbours Café + Provisions (formerly Gaia Grocery) is Tofino's community hub combining specialty espresso drinks, locally sourced groceries, and fresh lunch options under one roof. New owners Kevin and Marie — the team behind Cocofino dairy-free yogurt — took over the Gaia Grocery space and have built it into a neighbourhood gathering spot that serves both long-time locals and visitors passing through. For touring cyclists, it offers a compact grocery stop and café in the heart of Tofino.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (20 spaces, covered) at 31m; stands (4 spaces) at 87m; stands (6 spaces) at 89m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m. Total: 34 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gaiagrocery.ca now hosts 'Neighbours Café + Provisions,' a rebranded grocery store and café; the About page explicitly describes the transition from Gaia Grocery to new ownership ('Out with the old, in with the Neighbours. Same spot, new ownership, new everything'). The website confirms groceries and lunch offerings but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenity. Phone (250-725-0237) and address (150 4th Street, Tofino) are drawn from the website since OSM tags lack both.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Gaia Grocery' but the business has undergone a full ownership change and rebrand to 'Neighbours Café + Provisions'. The About page explicitly states 'Out with the old, in with the Neighbours. Same spot, new ownership, new everything.' The OSM node should be updated to reflect the current operating name.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 10:00-20:00) differ from the website's stated hours of 10am–7pm daily; website hours are likely more current.
No address or phone number in OSM tags; both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible grocery store and café in Tofino — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists. The OSM name is outdated but the business and location are confirmed active.

Hot food.detail: Website: 'yummy lunch options' alongside espresso drinks and frozen yogurt
